summaryShort: Their old wounds and defenses press against how freely you present yourself and enter situations.
summaryDeep: Their old wounds and defenses press against how freely you present yourself and enter situations. Your natural manner can hit their sore spot without meaning to, and their flinch can read as criticism of who you are. It keeps happening until the sore spot gets named.
